text:
toni_cs: Hey all — customer kickoff tomorrow, asked for a tiny field-ops primer (1 page) + a 1-paragraph FAQ they can hand to their infra team. Needs to cover onboarding health checks, quick configs for caching/batching/streaming, and clear renewal-risk signals.

devin_se: I can assemble the primer. Keep it super scannable: bullets, copy-paste snippets, and 3 quick checks to run in first 24/72 hours.

nisha_sre: Add a minimal degraded flow they can run without contacting support: circuit-breaker toggles, model fallback order, and a safe throttling rule.

chloe_support: Ill pull the top support asks for the last quarter and include one-line answers. Were seeing more \"unexpected token burn\" and \"sporadic streaming stalls\".

matt_pm: Also include two renewal-risk KPIs we watch: sustained token/day +40% vs baseline and P95 latency > SLO for >2 hours. Make the wording customer-facing.

toni_cs: Good. Keep only platform-supported knobs. No internal flags. Devin, can you add a tiny example of a prefill job and a small load-test command so they can validate warm pools?

devin_se: Yep. Draft below (very compact):

devin_se: \"Field Ops Kickstart Primer (one pager)
- Objective: reduce friction on day0-7 and limit renewal risk by catching cost/latency regressions early.
- Quick preflight (copy/paste): run a 10-min prefill to warm 15% of active users and capture baseline:
```bash
# Prefill example (POST to hosted endpoint)
for i in $(seq 1 150); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" 
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
    -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-v1\",\"prompt\":\"welcome\",\"max_tokens\":64,\"metadata\":{\"prefill\":true}}' &
done
wait
```
- Batching guidance: for short prompts (<80 tokens) a target_batch_size=24, target_max_batch_wait_ms=25 balances latency & cost. For long responses (>512 tokens), disable aggressive batching (target_batch_size=4).
- KV cache: enable prefix_cache=true, prefix_ttl_seconds=600 for interactive sessions. For highly dynamic sessions use prefix_ttl_seconds=45.
- Streaming: enable for human-facing long outputs; set socket_timeout_ms=45000 and keepalive_interval_s=12 to reduce mobile stalls.
- Safety throttles: set daily_token_limit and per-minute_token_cap to prevent runaway spend during integration.
- 3 quick checks (run in order):
  1) Validate cache hits: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/observability/metrics?name=prefix_cache_hit_rate` (expect >40% after prefill)
  2) Warm-pool effectiveness: run 50 cold requests vs 50 warm requests and compare median latency. Warm should be ~50-80% of cold.
  3) Budget guard: create alert at 60% of daily_token_limit and verify alert delivery to ops pager/email.
- Degraded flow (30+ min tail pain):
  a) Flip routing to next region with capacity via Console routing policy.
  b) Reduce `max_generation_tokens` by 25% and `target_batch_size` by 50% to lower tail latency.
  c) Enable model fallback sequence: redwood-v1-quantized -> redwood-v1-small -> redwood-v2-compact.
  d) If error rate persists, enable temporary per-client-rate-limit (100 req/min) and open cs ticket.
- What to capture for support: timestamped sample request JSON, route.name, account_id, prompt_hash, and whether the request was prefilling/warm.
- Signals that increase renewal risk (first 72h):
  * Token/day > baseline * 1.4 for 24+ hours;
  * P95 latency > SLO for 2+ hours;
  * Sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 30+ min.
- Escalation: open support ticket with label `cs:kickstart-review` -> CS will route to eng for config review and temporary protections.\"

chloe_support: FAQ paragraph (very short):
- Q: Why did tokens spike after integration? A: Often the client is sending verbose system prompts per request or missing local dedupe. Check for duplicated prompts and add client-side dedupe.
- Q: How to confirm warm pools working? A: Compare cold vs warm median latencies; confirm prefix_cache_hit_rate and warm_request_latency metrics.
- Q: Streaming stalls on web or mobile? A: Increase keepalive and socket timeout; ensure proxies (NGINX, LB) allow long-lived connections and do not buffer.
- Q: How to control spend during pilot? A: Set daily_token_limit + per-minute caps and alert at 60% consumption.

nisha_sre: Add a short load-test snippet for simulation (non-prod):
```bash
# quick burst test (non-prod key)
heyload --concurrency 30 --duration 120s --url https://staging-api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
  --header \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY\" --body-file sample_prompt.json
```
(We recommend running against staging to validate warm pools without billing impact.)

matt_pm: Suggest we replace raw model names with placeholders in the customer-facing PDF (e.g., \"primary model, compact fallback\") to avoid confusing customers about exact SKUs.

devin_se: Good call. I'll phrase those as friendly names in the final doc. Also will add the tiny JSON config blob customers can paste into Console integrations:
```json
{\"runtime\":{\"batching\":{\"target_batch_size\":24,\"max_batch_wait_ms\":25},\"kv_cache\":{\"prefix_cache\":true,\"prefix_ttl_seconds\":600},\"streaming\":{\"enabled\":true,\"keepalive_s\":12}}}
```

toni_cs: Love it. Chloe: can you test the FAQ wording is non-technical enough for ops?

chloe_support: Done. Tweaked one line to say \"warm pools = prefilled cache\" for clarity.

doc_bot: doc_bot: Draft created at /portal-drafts/cs/field-ops-kickstart-v2 (preview https://portal.redwood.internal/drafts/6721).

toni_cs: Thanks team, I'm going to convert to PDF + short HTML cheat sheet and attach to the kickoff email. Assign owner: toni_cs. Due: tomorrow 11am PT.

matt_pm: I'll add the one-line renewal-risk escalation to the contract playbook: if the customer sees two signals in \"Signals that increase renewal risk\" in 72h, trigger an immediate review with CS+Eng.

nisha_sre: One more ops tip: include a step for customers to add `X-Request-ID` in headers to make triage near-instant.

toni_cs: Added. Closing thread — will ping when live. :rocket:
